# kpastro
A precise Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) Vedic astrology engine in pure Python, powered by the Swiss Ephemeris for arc-second accuracy.
Documentation: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/
Installation: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/installation/
API reference: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/api-reference/
Examples: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/examples/
FAQ: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/faq/
Mathematics: https://rituparno-majumdar.github.io/kp-astrology/mathematics/
